newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Optus says may start to pay tax in 1997/98 yr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Optus says may start to pay tax in 1997/98 yr.

text.p: Telecommunications carrier Optus Communications Pty Ltd said on Wednesday that it plans to start paying tax in the financial year to June 30, 1998.

"Obviously it depends on the level of profitability, but it won't be the next financial year, possibly the year beyond that it may have some impact," Optus chief financial officer David Aner told reporters.

Optus earlier reported its first annual profit since it started operations in 1992. The group posted a profit before tax of A$60.3 million for 1995/96 year, compared with a loss of A$17.0 million a year earlier.
Optus shareholders include Mayne Nickless Ltd, BellSouth Corp and Cable and Wireless Plc, which each hold about one-quarter of the company.
